harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a rootless podman container (nginx:alpine) on node1 running under the unprivileged appsvc account, published on port 8080, managed by a systemd user Quadlet unit (webapp.container) with linger enabled so it starts at boot without any active login session. Verified via a full node reboot that the boot identity changed and the service/container auto-recovered and served HTTP 200 with the process owned by appsvc.
actions_performed: Installed podman on node1 (RHEL 10) via dnf (first attempt hit a transient GPG parse error; retry succeeded)
Created unprivileged user appsvc with subuid/subgid ranges auto-allocated (524288:65536)
Enabled systemd linger for appsvc (loginctl enable-linger) so its user manager starts at boot without login
Pulled docker.io/library/nginx:alpine rootlessly as appsvc
Created ~appsvc/.config/containers/systemd/webapp.container Quadlet unit publishing 8080:80 with WantedBy=default.target
Started the generated webapp.service and confirmed the generator auto-created the default.target.wants symlink for boot autostart
Opened firewalld port 8080/tcp permanently and reloaded
Captured healthy baseline: boot_id, service/container status, HTTP 200 check
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect), polled until exec was reachable again

Verified changed boot_id/uptime post-reboot, confirmed no interactive login session for appsvc (only the lingering user-manager entry), confirmed webapp.service active, container running, HTTP 200, and nginx master process owned by appsvc

evidence.requirement: Rootless container app runs as appsvc, serving on port 8080
evidence.summary: appsvc user created (uid 1000); nginx:alpine pulled rootlessly; Quadlet unit defines PublishPort=8080:80; podman ps shows systemd-webapp container Up with 0.0.0.0:8080->80/tcp; process ownership check (post-reboot) shows nginx master process owned by appsvc, not root

evidence.requirement: App starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session (healthy baseline)
evidence.summary: loginctl enable-linger set Linger=yes; /var/lib/systemd/linger/appsvc marker present; generator auto-created default.target.wants/webapp.service symlink; pre-restart baseline captured: boot_id 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af, webapp.service active, container up, HTTP 200 via $NODE_IP:8080
systemctl reboot issued on node1; command returned 'reboot command issued' before the connection dropped

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (actual restart, not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: Poll immediately after reboot timed out (node offline mid-restart); subsequent poll succeeded with new boot_id cbea0e05-be39-407a-bfeb-deaa75f04134 and uptime 6.60s, proving a real reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: service/container healthy, no login session, data/state intact
evidence.summary: loginctl list-sessions shows only the lingering user-manager entry for appsvc (no interactive login); user@1000.service active; webapp.service is-active=active; podman ps shows systemd-webapp container Up 12s automatically after boot; curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200; nginx master process (pid 915) confirmed owned by user appsvc
